section_summary: This section records Japanese requests for transport and training-ship visits to Los Angeles and Hawaiian ports in 1940, followed by State Department referrals and agency replies. It also includes naval reports about Japanese tankers at San Pedro. By October, Navy concerns about observing fleet movements led State Department staff to favor Los Angeles visits while declining proposed visits to Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Naval instructions for tanker searches

subfiles.summary: Promises usual courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Navy memorandum on tanker inspections

subfiles.summary: Includes an overheard claim of a fleet order toward Java, an order for tanker masters to report to their consul, and Navy instructions to search concentrated ship arrivals for concealed men or material.

subfiles.summary: Requests customary facilities if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Shiriya referral to Treasury

subfiles.about: State approves Shiriya's visits with a Honolulu shore-recreation limit.

subfiles.summary: Suggests notifying Governor Joseph B. Poindexter.

subfiles.title: Taisei Maru seamen-visa cross-reference

subfiles.summary: Asks whether cadets absent from the crew list need visaed passports.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for three vessels
subfiles.about: Naruto, Tsurumi, and Kyokuto Maru seek fuel and supply calls.
subfiles.summary: Provides October and November itineraries and requests crew landing and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel notice to California governor
subfiles.about: State reports the three vessels' proposed port calls.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary facilities if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel referral to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State requests customary facilities for three Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists Los Angeles fuel calls and Honolulu supply calls.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel referral to Interior
subfiles.about: State requests Interior's view on the three vessels.
subfiles.summary: The surviving text lists the proposed itinerary.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel referral to Attorney General
subfiles.about: State asks about the visits and landing of the vessels' crews.
subfiles.summary: Lists the ships, ports, purposes, and proposed dates.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel referral to Navy
subfiles.about: State seeks Navy's view on three proposed Japanese vessel visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Embassy request and asks for customary courtesies at the proposed ports.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel referral to Treasury
subfiles.about: State requests customs facilities for the three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Most itinerary text is poorly legible.

subfiles.title: Three-vessel referral to War
subfiles.about: State requests War Department's view on the three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists proposed Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of three-vessel request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the three-vessel request pending agency consultation.
subfiles.summary: Notes the crew-landing request and promises a further response.

subfiles.title: War response on three vessels
subfiles.about: War orders customary courtesies for the three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department commanders are instructed.

subfiles.title: Interior response on three vessels
subfiles.about: Hawaii's governor agrees to customary courtesies for the vessels.
subfiles.summary: Interior relays Joseph B. Poindexter's reply.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on Attorney General coordination
subfiles.about: Attorney General's office is told the planned Embassy reply.
subfiles.summary: Los Angeles authorities will extend courtesies to the ships.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs recommendation on three vessels
subfiles.about: Staff recommends approving Los Angeles calls but declining Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: Navy fears that Honolulu visits could permit observation of United States Navy movements. Staff also warns that denying oil calls at Los Angeles could be read as a practical embargo. It recommends approving the Los Angeles visits only.

subfiles.title: Embassy reply declining Honolulu visits
subfiles.about: State declines the three vessels' Honolulu calls while allowing Los Angeles calls.
subfiles.summary: The draft's lower text is poorly legible.

subfiles.title: Protocol note on Shiriya's alternate port
subfiles.about: Navy suggests a longer San Francisco stay for Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: The proposed November 9–14 dates replace a shorter stay.

subfiles.title: Protocol routing note on Shiriya reply
subfiles.about: Protocol asks that the Shiriya reply be checked with Navy.
subfiles.summary: Refers to the Ambassador's October 10 note.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Shiriya
subfiles.about: Shiriya seeks November calls at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Requests fuel, supplies, crew landing, and usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Reply to November Shiriya request
subfiles.about: State declines Shiriya's proposed Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: The damaged final lines appear to offer an alternate San Francisco visit.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on three vessels
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs courtesies for Naruto, Tsurumi, and Kyokuto Maru.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Los Angeles and Honolulu are instructed.
